description: A former EU lawmaker was hacked with Pegasus spyware while investigating its use, according to Citizen Lab. title: Pegasus Used Against MEP Investigating Pegasus, Citizen Lab Finds

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Sysdig reports an AI agent ran a full ransomware attack end-to-end, exploiting flaws, stealing creds, moving laterally, and encrypting data without humans. Sysdig’s Threat Research Team has documented what it assesses to be the first ransomware operation driven end-to-end by a large language model. The operator, which Sysdig calls JADEPUFFER, broke into a server, harvested […]
title: JADEPUFFER: First End-to-End AI-Driven Ransomware Operation

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Vercel breach happened after an employee used an unvetted AI tool. Attackers exploited it as a trusted link to access systems, steal data, and extort $2M. title: The Anatomy of a Shadow AI Supply-Chain Breach: Lessons from the 2026 Vercel Incident

title: Law enforcememt operation disrupted Malicious Residential Proxy Networks NetNut

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Government and healthcare sectors have weak email security. Many domains lack SPF, DMARC, DKIM, and MTA-STS, leaving them open to phishing attacks. Comparitech analyzed live DNS records for 5,849 domains across 13 sectors and scored each one out of 8 points based on four standard email authentication protocols: SPF, DMARC, DKIM, and MTA-STS. The results […]
title: Government and Healthcare Are the Weakest Links in Global Email Security
